scope: event-point behavior extraction only; no signals or backtests

early_warning: A correction/reversal distinction is probabilistic at its start.
Structural confirmation requires a prior swing breach and follow-through, which the current bank does not store explicitly.
The first post-event candle is treated as a rotation-bar proxy, not as a definitive reversal candle.

power_vs_pressure.power: range multiplied by volume; describes participation and expansion.
power_vs_pressure.pressure: directional body and return; wick imbalance can show rejection or absorption.
power_vs_pressure.caution: A large candle with a long opposing wick can have high power but failed directional pressure.
